summary: Create and tighten FedEx state, cache, database, ledger, export, and label files with owner-only permissions and reject unsafe symlink targets.
reason: FedEx state can contain recipient PII, tracking data, negotiated charges, labels, and raw API responses; permissive files or symlink-following writes can disclose or overwrite sensitive data.
validated_outcome: Tests create permissive legacy paths, verify directories are tightened to 0700 and sensitive files to 0600, reject symlink and non-regular targets through descriptor-relative operations, verify SQLite sidecars while open, keep label paths within the selected directory, replace exports atomically, and prevent raw FedEx response persistence.
